notes.title: Ver3.2.0 update
notes.content:
The problem of not being able to play in some areas has been fixed again.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused to customers who were unable to play in some areas. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
In the unlikely event that you were unable to play, please contact me for further assistance.

notes.title: Ver3.1.0 update
notes.content:
We've fixed the problem of not being able to play in some areas, and a few other minor glitches!

To those who could not play in some areas, we apologize for the inconvenience. I am sorry.

notes.title: MULTILINGUAL UPDATE !
notes.content:
We have added multilingual support!
In addition to Japanese, we have added English, Simplified Chinese, and "Meow" and "Nyan"(Japanese cat's meow)!

You can switch the language setting by clicking the gear symbol in the lower right corner of the title screen or by pressing the Escape key on the title screen!
Enjoy fireworks with people from all over the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465867/4f8fe2f392c48f26acab8a1354441edf3a8b8b0a.png[/img]

If you set the language setting to "Meow", most of the text will be in "Meow"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465867/517385e14188eaf6724713cf5948f3fb6cb6881e.png[/img]

notes.title: Ver2.5.0 update
notes.content:
We added a full screen mode to the game! 🎇
We changed some of the UI.

We fixed some bugs, such as the firework fire going out.
We hope you continue to enjoy this game.

notes.title: 2022 Summer Update !
notes.content:
We've updated our word choices!
　I've included some of the words that you guys have been asking me for on Twitter! Thank you!
　Please try to find your favorite combination of words.

We've adjusted the appearance of the sparklers. Watch the fireworks until the end.

You can now adjust the volume in-game! You did it!

We've added a Steam Review button on the screen after you hit "Go Home"!
　We'd love it if you'd leave us a review, even if it's just a quick one!

Other minor tweaks!
